### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | crisprseq output directory (cigar/, clonality/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, reference, protospacer, template). Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. The crisprseq input schema fixes it to sample. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the dashboard groups and filters libraries by. Defaults to protospacer, the guide each library was edited with. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `SKIP_CLONALITY` | — | Set (--var SKIP_CLONALITY=true) for a run with --skip_clonality: clonality/ is absent, so the clonality collection is removed. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`crisprseq/clonality.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/crisprseq/clonality.py) | Clonality call per library, from the crisprseq clonality classifier. | `sample`, `classification`, `clonality`, `class_confidence`, `total_reads`, `wt_pct`, `deletion_pct`, `insertion_pct`, `delins_pct`, `inframe_pct`, `frameshift_pct`, `indel_peaks`, `max_peak_pct`, `mean_peak_pct`, `peak_occupancy` |
| [`crisprseq/edit_outcomes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/crisprseq/edit_outcomes.py) | Edit outcome composition, one row per library and outcome class. | `sample`, `outcome`, `level`, `reads`, `pct` |
| [`crisprseq/edit_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/crisprseq/edit_summary.py) | Read accounting and edit outcome rates, one row per library. | `sample`, `classified_reads`, `edited_pct`, `indel_pct`, `frameshift_pct`, `inframe_pct`, `template_based_pct`, `frameshift_of_indels_pct`, `raw_reads`, `clustered_reads`, `aligned_pct`, `quality_filtered_pct`, `merged_pct`, `edited_reads`, `wt_reads`, `template_based_reads`, `delins_reads`, `ins_inframe_reads`, `ins_frameshift_reads`, `del_inframe_reads`, `del_frameshift_reads`, `wt_failing_filter`, `indels_failing_filter`, `indels_above_error_in_peak`, `indels_above_error_outside_peak`, `indels_below_error_in_peak`, `indels_below_error_outside_peak` |
| [`crisprseq/indels.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/crisprseq/indels.py) | Indel alleles per library, relative to the cut site. | `sample`, `allele`, `indel_type`, `start`, `length`, `size`, `offset`, `frame`, `peak`, `reads`, `pct_reads`, `pct_indel_reads`, `rank`, `cut_site` |
| [`nf-core/crisprseq/guide_alleles.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/crisprseq/recipes/guide_alleles.py) | The indel alleles of each guide, pooled over its libraries. | `guide`, `allele`, `libraries`, `pct_reads`, `reads`, `indel_type`, `size`, `offset`, `frame`, `peak`, `median_pct_reads`, `rank` |
| [`nf-core/crisprseq/guide_cut_site_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/crisprseq/recipes/guide_cut_site_profile.py) | Indel position profile around the cut site per guide: median library and interquartile band. | `guide`, `offset`, `median_deletion_pct`, `q1_deletion_pct`, `q3_deletion_pct`, `median_insertion_pct`, `q1_insertion_pct`, `q3_insertion_pct`, `libraries_with_signal` |
| [`nf-core/crisprseq/guide_indel_sizes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/crisprseq/recipes/guide_indel_sizes.py) | Indel size distribution per guide: the median library with its interquartile band. | `guide`, `size`, `median_pct_reads`, `q1_pct_reads`, `q3_pct_reads`, `libraries_with_signal` |
| [`nf-core/crisprseq/guide_outcomes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/crisprseq/recipes/guide_outcomes.py) | Edit outcome composition per guide. | `guide`, `outcome`, `level`, `reads`, `pct` |
